name: modelship-cpu
description: Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible inference for the agentic era. Modelship runs your whole AI stack -- reasoning LLMs with universal tool calling, embeddings, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and image generation -- as multiple models sharing your CPU behind a single OpenAI-compatible gateway. Built on Ray Serve with pluggable backends (llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers, plugins). This is the CPU-only variant -- no GPU or NVIDIA Container Toolkit needed, works on any box (amd64 or arm64, including Apple Silicon hosts). For GPU support instead, use the separate "modelship-cuda" template. IMPORTANT: create your models.yaml at the path below BEFORE starting the container -- it will not start without one. See https://github.com/modelship-ai/modelship/blob/main/docs/model-configuration.md and https://github.com/modelship-ai/modelship/tree/main/config/examples for the format and ready-made examples. IMPORTANT: --shm-size is shared memory Ray uses to pass data between models fast. The default 2g is fine for a single small quick-start model; raise it (roughly 30% of the RAM you want to give modelship) for bigger or multi-model stacks, or things will slow down.

paths.name: Models Config
paths.description: Your models.yaml defining which models to run on CPU. MUST exist before first start or the container will exit. See docs/model-configuration.md and config/examples/ in the modelship repo for the format.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Persistent cache for downloaded model weights (HuggingFace, vLLM, plugins). Keep this outside the container so weights survive updates/restarts.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible API port (chat completions, embeddings, STT, TTS, images)

ports.name: Metrics Port
ports.description: Prometheus metrics scrape port (Ray cluster, Ray Serve, vLLM, and modelship:* metrics). Only useful if Metrics Enabled is true.

variables.name: HF_TOKEN
variables.description: HuggingFace access token, required only for gated models (e.g. Llama, Gemma, Mistral variants).

variables.name: MSHIP_API_KEYS
variables.description: Comma-separated API keys clients must send as 'Authorization: Bearer key'. Leave empty to disable auth (fine for a LAN-only deployment).

variables.name: MSHIP_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, or WARNING.

variables.name: MSHIP_METRICS
variables.description: Enable Prometheus metrics on the Metrics Port. Set to false to disable.
